description: Canoe-body hull resistance model parameters. The hull inputs (Lwl, Bwl, Tc, canoe volume, canoe wetted area, displacement) come from hull_hydro.json conditions.sailing.result, and any ORC quantities from conditions.sailing.orc; this file holds the model choice, the water properties and the model's data.

density.source: Python-VPP HydroMod default rho (commit 9b9fe8f3f63d902a1df207691109e42932d0a9bb), so the comparison with hull_resistance_reference.json is like for like. The ORC VPP Documentation 2023 gives no value.

dynamic_viscosity.source: Python-VPP HydroMod default mu (same commit); kinematic viscosity is mu / rho. The ORC VPP Documentation 2023 gives no value.

drag_surfaces.source: ORC VPP Documentation 2023 section 6.3.1 canoe-body residuary resistance surfaces, the file as shipped by Python-VPP; see data/hull/README.md.

immersed_rail.note: Rr multiplied by 1 + coefficient (heel_deg - threshold_deg)^2 above threshold_deg, 1 otherwise. NOT in the ORC VPP Documentation 2023: it is Python-VPP's immersed-rail correction (HydroMod._get_Rr), kept because the Python-VPP downwind target is computed with it.

coefficients.source: Keuning & Sonnenberg 1998 DSYHS regressions as reproduced in Molland, Turnock & Hudson, Ship Resistance and Propulsion, 2nd ed., Tables 10.13, 10.14 and 10.26; see data/hull/README.md.

form_factor.source: The DSYHS uses no form factor on the ITTC-57 friction (Keuning & Sonnenberg 1998, as reported by Molland et al. section 10.3.6.2 and Kleijweg 2015 section 2.1.2); the hull-shape effect is inside the residuary regression.
